en: Advertising postcard for the Szent György Fogadó (Saint George Inn) in Pécs, Hungary. The front side shows a black‑and‑white photograph of the corner building that houses the inn, alongside a detailed street map of central Pécs with a marked location. At the bottom is an invitation line in Hungarian. The reverse side is a standard blank postcard layout with space for a stamp, address lines, and dividing line for message and address.
